body:
Current Engram binary for pinned TermAl live runs, and the latest Engram install (Termal::Fable2; condensed again at revision 40, 2026-10-09 22:35Z; full history in revisions 1-39).

PIN RULE. A `live --engram-binary --engram-sha256` run uses the pinned binary until a run needs a newer one. The pin is still Engram 08a04e0 (w-63757ebca393): exe sha256 bcec822ae785fc97a16fcb66efae3f4205ded4f6cd6c60d33a29f008b7c23c13, build_fingerprint 081842231d48c5f4adac88d847e6098dc2b46ad5a66775171d07719327ca1eff; backup engram-20261005T183302Z-081842231d48.exe (install notice ebe242f7 #668). Re-pin only when a TermAl check needs newer behaviour. Any check pinned to an intermediate build must re-pin when that build is replaced. w-47338 will need an occurrence_id-capable pin (43f5cd8 or later) when its first stage tests.

LATEST INSTALL. 2026-10-09 22:31:50Z (ebe242f7 #998): Engram 2de7a4b88ab1, a fast-forward from 74566af4 (w-ce934440fc5d + w-7703351dc879). A stale selected unblock (its identical attempt retired) now explains that no clear happened and offers a runnable show. Core and service blocker refusals keep the raw blocker_id wording; agent CLI and MCP refusals name --blocker SELECTOR. Genuine changed-intent conflicts are unchanged. Exe sha256 59f77f987e70852e719178744b2bbd73ed43cd51963ec9b2b3c7ce9f144cf2ff, build 22f25568fc0fe91c5ff78d032f582ba7e5a1acbf9242f31a299d906e8914eed1; backup of 96f5114c kept; gap-free swap. No schema change; all 4 stores ready; no restart. Running MCP servers pick it up at their next ordinary restart. Pins unaffected.

RECENT INSTALLS, 2026-10-09 (all fast-forwards, no schema change, gap-free swaps after 18:33Z; hashes in revisions 36-39):
- 21:25Z #970, 74566af4 (w-edf6461efa20): a note write that finds the store write-locked waits up to one shared 10 s window, then returns a typed admission refusal. Outward codes are unchanged, and the "database is locked" phrase that TermAl's reader matches is kept. Exe 5cf40faa…, build 96f5114c.
- 20:22Z #960, 411f8a83 (w-febdd6deafd2): BEHAVIOUR. A refused done, evaluate, update, propose or handoff no longer moves focus when the refusal can be decided from the request alone. This matters for TermAl's turn-start-focus credit rule. Build b3739096.
- 19:39Z #954, d994bf57: tooling only (test-rust in four phases). Build 25696904.
- 18:33Z #946, 8acf84e7: opt-in MCP shutdown trace; default path unchanged. Build 1d166eeb.
- 17:44Z #944, 84d045ca: docs only. Build 96c67609.
- 17:35Z #942, 4466cf6c: the launcher writes request.json `detached`, a stage `cwd` and tests `runner: "node-test"` for direct focused `node --test` runs, so Engram focused Node runs can earn TermAl credit. Build b1f4abd9.
- Between 00:44Z and 16:35Z: wording, docs or test changes only (#891, #892, #895, #896, #901, #914, #918, #936); hashes in revision 34.

INSTALL-GAP INCIDENT, 17:43Z. During the 84d045ca swap, C:\Users\grzeg\.cargo\bin\engram.exe was briefly absent. An evaluation request failed with 502 "failed resolving Engram program ...engram.exe ... (os error 2)". Engram has used gap-free swaps since then (copy to .new, then two back-to-back renames). If a host-side engram call fails with os error 2, check whether an install is in progress before diagnosing, then retry once.

RUNNING MCP SERVERS pick up a newer install only at the next TermAl restart (or when their session is recreated). A TermAl control sidecar picks it up after its idle reap.

BEHAVIOUR HISTORY SINCE THE PIN. Fast-forwards with no store-format change unless noted; details are in revisions up to 25.
- 92fc3d0: atomic new-store open (a cold store gives typed busy).
- 321b80a: verification_bind.
- 47f3cff: ancestor .engram-project search (TermAl passes --project-file, so it is unaffected).
- 835c846: bare done/evaluate refused with several live claims (TermAl passes work_ref).
- d8ec5a4: the marker is a regular file of at most 4096 bytes.
- 7b8d87e: status-grouped verification view (TermAl's reader tolerates both shapes).
- 496ab34: the ambiguity refusal lists up to 3 refs.
- 86c82c8: the citation refusal names the mismatch.
- 581bf6c: extended-length store paths.
- 8ca2538: typed refusal above 1024 prerequisites.
- 7306ac3: bare core-complete guard (TermAl calls neither core complete nor work_complete).
- 2026-10-06: 7340a47 and 6eff095 (graph snapshot restore performance); 2f87464 (faster waive/work reads); 6679442 (additive host-control turn_grant_read; TermAl consumer foundation w-f79e3484ac46, parked); 43f5cd8 (a required opaque occurrence_id per new restore in store.restore.json; an id-less legacy record is Unreadable, failing closed; TermAl's half is open on w-4be3e96f76b8); a112b1f (turn_grant_read refuses out-of-range timestamps with control_projection_invalid); ab55fda (doctor reports a seal finding once); 3f3f24be63a7 (stale-evaluation wording `unadmitted_change`).
- 2026-10-09: d7395955 (offer-aware handoff disposal guidance); 2e0091cf (race-safe retirement of a refused selected-unblock attempt); 411f8a83, 74566af4 and 2de7a4b8 above.

Report any reader mismatch on real records to Engram::Fable.
